items.docs:
Transcribe your audio or video files. The input file can have one of the following mime types:
  * audio/flac
  * audio/mpeg
  * audio/x-m4a
  * audio/ogg
  * audio/x-wav
  * video/mp4
  * video/mpeg
  * video/webm
Note, that the maximum audio/video file size supported is 25mb.

params.name: transaction_id
params.description: The Transaction ID returned from the [Transcribe Audio](https://docs.picsart.io/reference/video-transcribe-audio-1).

items.docs: Use this method, along with transaction_id, to retrieve the audio transcription.
